source: Project Operating System Phase 4 - Validation Engine
description: Supported declarative validation types for future compliance checks.

items.description: Validates SEO requirements and metadata consistency.
Validates HTML structure and project markup standards.
Validates JSON-LD structure and required properties.
Validates JSON schemas, contracts and data shape.
Validates links, internal navigation and broken references.
Validates layout structure and visual consistency requirements.
Validates accessibility requirements and review evidence.
Validates runtime safety and protected file boundaries.
Validates article and content structure requirements.
Validates future offer placement boundaries and evidence.

notes: Types are protocol labels only; no validation runner is implemented in Phase 4.
